items.condition: Any result substitutes a different crystal, changes composition/protonation, or cannot map results to the three specified CCDC objects.
A numerical gap is reported without per-object calculation provenance and stability or an explicitly documented bounded failure.
The report asserts a trend or orbital assignment without band/DOS/projection evidence tied to the named object.
Calls the higher component-resolved gap the fundamental gap, mixes same-k with independent-edge differences or SOC with no-SOC values, or labels non-Gamma as automatically indirect.
Selects a fixed band ordinal/target-nearest energy without lower-state/component evidence, or claims optical allowedness solely because Pb projection is nonzero.
